prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED DEEP MAROON flat color field — think #7A2E3A,
the color of authority, constraint, and bound doctrine on a semantic
map. The hue must read as DARK MAROON, not black, not grey, not the
brighter crimson of lineage. Clearly distinct from crags brown and from
silence violet. Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with this
one deep-maroon color corner to corner — NO drawn hex, NO paper border,
NO vignette, NO centered composition, NO symbols, NO chains, NO figures,
NO script. Only the faintest paint-texture variation within the same
maroon hue. A semantic terrain region-fill swatch, not an illustration.

formatted_prompt.scene: Bold flat comic-map terrain tile rendered in saturated ink wash, pure deep-maroon color field filling the entire square edge-to-edge with faint brushwork texture variation within the same dark-maroon hue, no figures, no symbols, only vivid constrained-burgundy wash.

subjects.description: Edge-to-edge flat terrain wash, deep dark-maroon hue with subtle paint-texture variation, uniform saturated fill across the full 1024x1024 square, faint brushstroke grain within the same maroon tone.
subjects.position: fills entire frame corner to corner
